study_identification_part.si4_title: Individual-level deviations from normative brain morphology in violence, psychosis, and psychopathy

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The study clearly states its objective and hypotheses. It aims to assess the potential of normative modeling in forensic psychiatry by investigating individual patterns of deviations in specific groups (SSD-V, SSD-NV, nonSSD-V, HC). Hypotheses regarding interindividual variability and specific regional deviations are provided.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: The objective of this study is to assess the potential of normative modeling in forensic psychiatry neuroimaging research by investigating individual patterns of deviations from the norm in persons with a history of severe violence and schizophrenia spectrum disorder (SSD-V)... We hypothesize that there will be high interindividual anatomical variability in persons with SSD-V...

nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.reason: The study uses pretrained normative models (BrainCharts) and cites the original publication (Rutherford et al., 2022). It also describes the eligibility and exclusion criteria for the local healthy control sample (n=998) used for model calibration (fine-tuning). Image quality control procedures (MRIqc, visual inspection) are detailed.
nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.supporting_text: We used pretrained normative models from https://github.com/predictiveclinical-neuroscience/braincharts... An unmatched group of healthy controls (n = 998) was utilized to fine-tune model parameters... Healthy participants were either drawn from the Norwegian national population registry (TOP, uTOP), or recruited by newspaper ads... inclusion criteria were age... and no history of neurological or severe mental disorders.

nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.reason: The study uses normative models that account for age and scanner. Sex is handled by using sex-specific charts (and the study only included males). Site effects were addressed by using scanner as a covariate in the model training (BrainCharts) and an additional harmonization step using a local calibration set for the current data.
nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.supporting_text: To model non-linear effects accurately, normative models were trained using Bayesian linear regression... independent variables were age and scanner... To account for the absence of scanner data used to acquire data in the model, an additional harmonization step was implemented.

cr2_handling_of_clinical_covariates.reason: The study analyzed the association between deviation scores and psychopathy traits (PCL-R), considering psychosis status. However, the authors explicitly state they did not control for substance use or cumulative effects of antipsychotic medication, which are key clinical covariates.
cr2_handling_of_clinical_covariates.supporting_text: Finally, to examine the association between PCL-R scores and deviation scores... PCL-R total score, age, psychosis status, and ICV... were included as independent variables. ... Moreover, the models were not corrected for substance use... Further, we did not control for cumulative effects of antipsychotic medication
